description: This file defines the ReviewerUserRole class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages access rights for reviewers to employee, performance tracker, and tracker log entities based on permissions and the reviewer's identity.

classes.name: ReviewerUserRole
classes.description: A class that manages reviewer user role permissions and access to specific entities such as employees, performance trackers, and tracker logs within the HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs of entities accessible to the reviewer based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs that the reviewer has access to, contingent on specific permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs accessible to the reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker log IDs associated with the reviewer.
